$about: The regression-case catalogue backfilled from the 2026-08-03 testing round. Every case traces to research/testing-log-2026-08-03.md (defect rows, the 8 Track B lifecycle scenarios, or the known-gaps list) or to VALIDATION-PLAN.md's own 15 exemplar cases. 'tests' cites SPEC.md rule numbers (R1-R25) or a docs/PRODUCT.md anchor where no rule fits. Eight of VALIDATION-PLAN.md's 15 exemplar cases cited a rule number that does not match their own description once checked against standard/SPEC.md (GATE-01: R17->R16; GATE-02/GATE-03: R13->R11; GATE-06: R14->R15; GATE-07: R12->R9; TRACK-03/TRACK-06: R14->R15; UPD-01: R19->R17) - corrected here; see the codify report for the detail. status: run = executed at least once with a recorded verdict in runs/2026-08-03.json; planned = specified, not yet executed; needs-procedure = the log describes a real finding but not enough to reconstruct a reproduction, so procedure is left empty rather than invented.
